column7: GroupGRPCService.AddGroupMember checked only roles.assign over gRPC, never the groups outer users.read gate HTTP RequirePermission(users.read) also enforces (authzdiff cross-layer differential harness waiver known-01, historical name D1) -- a roles.assign-only holder could add a group member over gRPC in cases REST denies. Initially left out of the sibling AUTHZDIFF-KNOWN01-GRPC-GROUP-READ-GATE fix on the mistaken premise that the harness's generated-permission sweep didn't flag it; review on the same PR traced the asymmetry directly. Fixed via authorizeGlobalMutation (conversions.go).
